findings.text: Central creation routine validates requested clone options and exit notification, expands empty mount request into new mount request, rejects aliased pid descriptor and parent identifier pointers when both are requested, rejects invalid exit notification, selects a tracer notification based on vfork mode and exit notification unless explicitly untraced and enabled, delegates duplication, records fork trace, resolves numeric identifier, optionally reports parent identifier to user, prepares vfork completion with extra reference, optionally accounts new memory for generational reclaim when memory is not shared, wakes the new task, notifies tracer, waits for vfork completion with done notification on success, releases identifier reference and returns numeric result or negative error.

Classic fork entry creates a child whose termination notification uses child signal through the central creation routine when memory management is configured, otherwise it reports invalid argument without creating anything.
Vfork entry requests blocking parent semantics with shared memory and child termination notification through the central creation routine.

Architecture dependent clone entry normalizes the low flag word into clone options and termination signal parts, wires legacy pid descriptor pointer to alias parent identifier pointer, and forwards child identifier pointer with stack and thread local storage values into the central creation routine.

Extended clone entry stages a bounded per namespace identifier array, copies a variable sized user argument block, validates normalized options, then delegates to the central creation routine, and reports unavailable on architectures lacking the entry.

User argument copy enforces compile time layout versions, rejects oversize and undersize blocks, rejects excessive or incoherent optional identifier list size and presence, rejects exit notification with high bits set, rejects cgroup delegation with out of range descriptor or undersize version, normalizes pointers and scalars into kernel form, and copies the optional identifier list with fault reporting.

Extended validation rejects unknown option bits beyond legacy plus explicitly allowed new options, rejects detached marker and signal bits except time namespace reuse, rejects simultaneous shared and cleared signal handling, rejects thread or parent sharing combined with nonzero exit notification, and requires a valid stack description.
Stack validation requires empty stack to have zero size and nonzero stack to have nonzero size with user accessible range, and normalizes the pointer to the top on architectures with downward growth.

In kernel thread helpers build creation arguments that force shared memory and untraced operation while preserving caller supplied signal selection for termination, attach supplied entry function with argument and optional name, and mark the new execution context as kernel thread or user mode helper before delegating to the central creation routine.

Process tree walk holds task list for reading, starts from thread group leader of the supplied task, iterates every thread and its children depth first invoking caller visitor, descends on positive visitor result, aborts and releases lock on negative result, and ascends via real parent chain until returning to start.

Memory descriptor cache initialization computes object size as base descriptor plus processor mask storage plus concurrency identifier storage, creates a slab cache with hardware alignment and panic and accounting behavior and minimum alignment of zero, restricting user copy to the saved auxiliary vector region.

Early cache setup creates dedicated caches for signal handling state with type safe reclaim and constructor initializing its lock and signal file wait queue, for signal state, file tables and filesystem state, plus execution, mapping and namespace proxy initialization including a panicking accounted namespace proxy cache.

Unshare option check rejects bits outside thread, filesystem, signal handling, memory, file table, semaphore, full namespace set and empty mount marker, and requires solitary thread group for thread related detach, exclusive signal handling for signal or memory detach, and single threaded caller for memory detach.

Unshare state machine expands implied detach dependencies for user, memory, signal, empty mount and mount namespace cases, warns on namespace or filesystem detach with overridden filesystem state, validates options, stages new filesystem, file table, credentials, namespace proxy and semaphore detach decisions with ordered cleanup on failure, commits semaphore and shared memory separation, filesystem switch with old release, namespace switch, file table swap under lock, credential commit, and finally propagates namespace change to performance events.
Task list is held for reading across full tree traversal, and task lock serializes file table replacement during unshare and memory accounting at creation when memory is not shared.

Filesystem detach is a no operation when flag is absent or filesystem is missing, or when no new mount is requested and filesystem is exclusively owned, otherwise it duplicates the filesystem structure and reports allocation failure.

File table detach duplicates only when requested and currently shared, propagating duplication errors, and standalone file unshare helper swaps the duplicate under task lock and releases the old table, doing nothing when no duplicate was needed.
Namespace proxy destruction releases references for mount, uts, ipc, child pid, time, child time, cgroup and network namespaces, then returns the object to its slab cache.

Namespace unshare is a no operation without namespace bits excluding user bit, requires administrative capability in the target user namespace, normalizes the thirty two bit empty mount alias into its unique sixty four bit form, then delegates creation against either staged or current filesystem state and propagates creation errors.

User namespace unshare is a no operation without the user bit, otherwise it prepares new credentials, attempts user namespace creation, releases credentials on failure and publishes them on success, reporting allocation failure when preparation fails.
Unshare system entry forwards caller flag word directly to the staged unshare implementation and returns its status.

Control threads-max is exposed under kernel with mode 0644 and a dedicated handler, handler constrains values between one and implementation maximum and updates global maximum only on successful write, registered during early initialization.

Refrigerator loop records entry state, warns on unexpected sleeping state, marks current as frozen with running saved state under scheduler lock, rechecks freezing versus requested kernel thread termination under freezer lock, schedules while freezing persists, exits when thawed, restores running state and reports whether any freeze occurred.

Freezing decision exempts tasks marked non freezable or suspend worker and memory reclaim victims, treats signal less power freezing or group version one freezing as freezing for all, treats power freezing as freezing only for non kernel threads, otherwise reports not freezing.

Per task freeze attempt skips runnable tasks including delayed ones, skips remote currently executing tasks, requires freezable or stopped or traced state with a warning when freezable accompanies abnormal sleeping state and a lock ownership warning when unsafe marker is absent, then saves current state and marks frozen.
Freezer restore rewrites saved state when it differs from running and resets saved state to running, signalling that a change occurred, otherwise reports no action.
Thaw helper iterates all threads of the supplied process target under read side critical section and requests wake for each.

Freezable marker clears the non freezable flag under freezer lock to make the change visible to concurrent freezing checks, then attempts to enter freeze and reports its outcome, caller must be able to sleep.

Supplemental group storage allocates a flexible object sized for requested count with accounted memory, initializes reference count to one and records count, frees via virtual free, and credential update drops old reference, acquires new reference and installs the new pointer.

Group transfer to user translates each kernel identifier through current user namespace with per entry fault reporting, transfer from user reads each entry with fault reporting and rejects invalid mapped identifiers, and sorting orders identifiers ascending using a three way comparator based on greater and less predicates.

Hazards include silent misbehaviour if pid descriptor aliasing is not rejected, if invalid exit notification or stack or unknown clone options pass through, if namespace detach proceeds with overridden filesystem state, if freezing occurs while holding locks, and if child task pointer is touched after wakeup when it may have exited, vfork requires extra reference and completion coordination.

Freezer spin lock serializes freezable flag changes and freezing rechecks, scheduler private lock serializes transition into frozen with saved state update, and task list read lock serializes tree traversal against concurrent modification.
Minimum alignment for memory descriptor slab objects is zero.
Freezer activity indicator is a static branch key initially disabled.
Kernel thread termination query reports whether the stop flag is set in the current thread control block.
Thread maximum control handler uses temporary staging with minimum one and implementation maximum, delegates range checked vector handling, and commits to global maximum only on successful write.
Supplemental group container comprises usage reference count, group count and trailing variable length kernel identifier array sized by allocation time count.
Signal handling state contains a spin lock and a wait queue for signal file readers, initialized by its slab constructor.
